High range and arc, huge AoE auto-attack. Secondary attack casts ghost towards the enemies dealing 100% of Ability Power stats as [magical](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Magical "Magical") damage. Fully charged secondary attack spawns ghost knight that deals 500% of your Ability Power stats to all enemies he'll come through as [magical](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Magical "Magical") damage. Every attack style has different primary and secondary attack as well.
